Name: (CP) Magical Menagerie
Author: InaylaLinyah
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZOn1jTG.png[/img]﻿
- [u][size=4]Enchanted Chickens[/size][/u]
- Purchasable from Marnie for 20,000 gold
- Require a Deluxe Coop
- Can be hatched from both versions of enchanted eggs
- 12 different skins for you to choose from using Alternative Textures, otherwise they are randomized
- Drops Large enchanted eggs starting at 2 hearts
- Drops Fairy Dust starting at 5 hearts
- AHM support, favored treats are Fairy Rose, Cave Carrot, Corn, Wheat, and Sunflower Seeds
- Enchanted Mayonnaise (yes, you may drink it)

[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/En9PfFp.png[/img]﻿
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]﻿ (Gift tastes)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url]﻿
I am happy to offer further compatibility upon request!

Unzip the folder into your Mods folder or in your mod manager

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2UzKbY9.png[/img]﻿
[size=2]Reinstate Fae Gate support
[/size]Add more magical themed animals
Add more artisan goods
Add random chance events
Add recipes
Add NPC compatability
TLDR massively expand the mod to be more :)
